cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(bgfx_contract C CXX)
include(FetchContent)
set(BGFX_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS OFF)
set(BGFX_CUSTOM_TARGETS OFF)
set(BGFX_CONFIG_VIDEO OFF)
set(BGFX_INSTALL ON)
set(BGFX_CONFIG_MAX_DRAW_CALLS 42)
if(TEST_OPTIONS)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS ON)
	set(BGFX_CUSTOM_TARGETS ON)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_EXAMPLES ON)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_TESTS ON)
endif()
if(TEST_BIN2C)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS ON)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS_SHADER OFF)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS_GEOMETRY OFF)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS_TEXTURE OFF)
	set(BGFX_BUILD_EXAMPLE_COMMON OFF)
endif()
if(TEST_NORMAL_ROOTS)
	foreach(root BGFX BX BIMG)
		set(${root}_DIR "${TEST_${root}_DIR}")
	endforeach()
endif()
if(TEST_BGFX_REV)
	FetchContent_Declare(bgfx GIT_REPOSITORY "${TEST_BGFX_REPOSITORY}" GIT_TAG "${TEST_BGFX_REV}"
		GIT_SUBMODULES "" SOURCE_DIR "${FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR}/bgfx.cmake-src/bgfx"
		SOURCE_SUBDIR "_bgfx_population_only")
endif()
if(TEST_INTEGRATION)
	add_subdirectory(integration)
else()
	add_subdirectory("${TEST_WRAPPER}" "${FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR}/bgfx.cmake-build")
	set(bgfx.cmake_SOURCE_DIR "${TEST_WRAPPER}")
	set(bgfx.cmake_BINARY_DIR "${FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR}/bgfx.cmake-build")
endif()
foreach(target bgfx bx bimg bimg_decode bimg_encode)
	if(NOT TARGET ${target})
		message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing public target ${target}")
	endif()
endforeach()
if(TEST_OPTIONS)
	foreach(target bin2c shaderc geometryc texturec bx_test bx_bench bgfx-tools example-common)
		if(NOT TARGET ${target})
			message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing optional target ${target}")
		endif()
	endforeach()
endif()
get_target_property(definitions bgfx INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
if(NOT "BGFX_CONFIG_MAX_DRAW_CALLS=42" IN_LIST definitions)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "Parent normal option lost precedence: ${definitions}")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/resolved.txt"
	"${BGFX_DIR}\n${BX_DIR}\n${BIMG_DIR}\n${bgfx.cmake_SOURCE_DIR}\n${bgfx.cmake_BINARY_DIR}\n${BGFX_PROJECT_VERSION}\n")
if(TEST_STAGE)
	include("${TEST_WRAPPER}/cmake/stage-sources.cmake")
	bgfx_stage_sources("${TEST_WRAPPER}" "${TEST_STAGE}")
endif()
